label: Hospitals
note: BEA prices hospital care from this PPI rather than the CPI, and counts what insurers pay rather than what a household is billed.

label: Offices of physicians
note: Same: the physician-services deflator is PPI-sourced.

label: Direct health and medical insurance carriers
note: PCE values insurance at the carriers' margin; this PPI is that margin. The CPI has no comparable line.

label: Portfolio management
note: Portfolio management and investment advice: a PCE line with no CPI counterpart at all, so PPI is its only monthly input.

label: Scheduled passenger air transportation
note: Air fares are priced differently in the two gauges; the PPI is closer to what PCE does.
